1444.name: Herbal Tonic
1444.description: Bitter greens boiled down by somebody's grandmother. It genuinely helps.

1445.name: Field Medicine Kit
1445.description: The kit an army medic carries. It will not name your illness, but it will carry you.

1446.name: Penicillin Course
1446.description: The mould that changed everything, in ten numbered tablets. Finish the course.

1447.name: Doxycycline Course
1447.description: A tetracycline that goes where penicillin will not: ticks, lungs and the tropics.

1448.name: Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics
1448.description: Everything at once. It will clear the infection and most of what was keeping you upright.

1449.name: Vancomycin Vial
1449.description: The drug of last resort, drawn up when nothing else has worked.

1450.name: Antiviral Capsules
1450.description: It cannot kill a virus. It can stop it copying itself, which comes to the same thing.

1451.name: Interferon Course
1451.description: Your own alarm signal, bottled and given back to you in quantity.

1452.name: Antiretroviral Regimen
1452.description: Three drugs in one blister pack. It will not cure you. Taken daily, it means you live.

1453.name: Antifungal Powder
1453.description: Dusted into boots, gloves and everywhere else it has taken hold.

1454.name: Amphotericin Drip
1454.description: Nicknamed amphoterrible by everyone who has ever been given it. It works.

1455.name: Permethrin Lotion
1455.description: Applied neck to toe, left overnight, and everything you own washed hot.

1456.name: Delousing Kit
1456.description: A fine comb, a foul shampoo and an afternoon of somebody going through your hair.

1457.name: Albendazole Tablets
1457.description: Two tablets, and whatever has been eating your dinner stops.

1458.name: Vermifuge Draught
1458.description: Wormwood, tansy and a taste that anything living would leave a body to escape.

1459.name: Metronidazole Tablets
1459.description: For the single-celled things in the gut, and the reason you cannot drink for a week.

1460.name: Quinine Tablets
1460.description: Bark of the cinchona, pressed into tablets. The ringing in your ears means it is working.

1461.name: Chloroquine Tablets
1461.description: The modern answer, taken weekly before and daily after.

1462.name: Polyvalent Antitoxin
1462.description: Antibodies raised in a horse against the toxin, not the germ. It is the toxin that kills.

1463.name: Rabies Immunoglobulin
1463.description: Given into the wound itself, and only ever in time.

1464.name: Oral Rehydration Salts
1464.description: Salt, sugar and clean water in the one ratio that saves lives.

1465.name: Multivitamin Tablets
1465.description: Everything the diet has been missing, in one chalky tablet.

1466.name: Ascorbic Acid Tablets
1466.description: Vitamin C. The whole reason the Navy ever carried limes.

1467.name: B-Complex Injection
1467.description: The whole B family, given where swallowing it would not be enough.

1468.name: Cod Liver Oil
1468.description: A spoonful a day. It tastes of the sea and everything that has died in it.

1469.name: Iron Sulphate Tablets
1469.description: For a blood count that has fallen. It will fix the tiredness and ruin the stomach.

1470.name: Clotting Factor Vial
1470.description: The missing protein, given back. Without it a bruise is a hospital admission.

1471.name: Blood Transfusion Kit
1471.description: Bag, line and cannula. Somebody else's blood, and a great deal of it.

1472.name: Insulin Vial
1472.description: Twice a day, forever, with a syringe and a steady hand.

1473.name: Corticosteroid Course
1473.description: It turns the immune system down. Everything inflamed settles, and everything dormant wakes.

1474.name: Immunosuppressant Course
1474.description: For a body that has decided to attack itself, and must be talked out of it.

1475.name: Salbutamol Inhaler
1475.description: Two puffs and the airway opens. Carry it or do not go out.

1476.name: Beta-Blocker Tablets
1476.description: It slows the heart to something the heart can afford.

1477.name: Digitalis Tincture
1477.description: Foxglove, measured to the drop. One drop over is a poison and always was.

1478.name: Anticonvulsant Tablets
1478.description: It raises the threshold the brain has to cross before it goes off.

1479.name: Antidepressant Course
1479.description: Six weeks before it works, and everyone stops before week six.

1480.name: Antipsychotic Course
1480.description: It turns the volume down on everything, the useful things included.

1481.name: Lithium Carbonate Tablets
1481.description: A salt from a rock. Half a gram either way is the difference between well and poisoned.

1482.name: Sedative Draught
1482.description: It will not solve anything. It will let the person stop, which is often the whole treatment.

1483.name: Iodine Tincture
1483.description: Brown, stinging and undefeated by anything that lives on skin.

1484.name: Debridement Kit
1484.description: Scalpel, forceps and the unpleasant job of cutting away what has already died.

1485.name: Proton Pump Inhibitor
1485.description: It stops the stomach making acid at all, which is more drastic than it sounds.

1486.name: Blessed Water Phial
1486.description: Water from a font, carried in a phial. It burns exactly one kind of illness.

1487.name: Rite of Exorcism Kit
1487.description: Stole, salt, oil and the Roman text. It is a procedure, and it has a failure rate.

1488.name: Mana Purgative
1488.description: It flushes the channels, which hurts roughly as much as it sounds like it would.

1489.name: Ley Cauterisation Salts
1489.description: Salt packed into the ruined channel and lit. The rot stops where the burn starts.

1490.name: Witch's Tincture
1490.description: Nine drops under the tongue at the same hour daily, and no one asks what is in it.

1491.name: Debugging Nanites
1491.description: A swarm small enough to read what has gone wrong and rewrite it in place.

1492.name: Firewall Serum
1492.description: It puts a boundary back between you and whatever has been addressing you directly.

1493.name: Null Salve
1493.description: Rubbed into the skin, it makes the surface of you slightly less interesting to look at.

1494.name: Anchor Draught
1494.description: It gives you back a here and a now, both of which had been optional for a while.

1495.name: Panacea Draught
1495.description: The alchemist's answer to everything. Nearly everything. It has a list of exceptions and knows it.
